name: Medal
description: Clip the last moments of your game with Medal from your phone, take screenshots, and pop up when a clip is saved.
author: Tessel

clipKey.title: Clip hotkey
clipKey.description: The same as Medal › Settings › Hotkeys › Clip, e.g. f8 or alt+f10.

screenshotKey.title: Screenshot hotkey
screenshotKey.description: Medal › Settings › Hotkeys › Screenshot, if you use it.

recordKey.title: Start/stop recording hotkey
recordKey.description: Medal › Settings › Hotkeys › Start/stop recording, if you set one.

folder.title: Medal library folder
folder.description: Where Medal saves clips (Medal › Settings › Library). Empty looks in Videos\\Medal.

waitSeconds.title: Wait for the clip (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for Medal to save a clip before saying it did not.
